{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will end state-level use of private prisons and detention centers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will restrict state and local practices like solitary confinement, chokeholds, and restraints on pregnant inmates.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will guarantee access to medical care in prison.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will eliminate profiteering from diversion, bail, electronic monitoring, commissaries, and reentry programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will support rehabilitation and education, including college programs, for inmates in prison and after their release.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will boost access to transitional housing, affordable housing, mental health and substance use treatment to help returning citizens succeed upon their release.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will limit federal reincarceration to only serious violations of supervised release.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to expand \"ban the box\" so returning citizens can more easily find work.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the right to vote for returning citizens.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the right to public services like Pell Grants and nutrition assistance for returning citizens.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump's Administration threatened federal prosecution for marijuana cases in states where marijuana was legal.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump granted fewer clemency requests than nearly every president since the start of the 20th century.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Many of Trump's clemency grants were reserved for well-connected offenders and close friends and associates like Steve Bannon, Roger Stone, Paul Manafort, Michael Flynn, and Charles Kushner.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's Administration cut support for halfway houses.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's Administration decreased the number of federal prisoners sent to transitional housing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump's Administration reinstated contracts with private prisons.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
